items.title: 战斗 · 紧凑推进 144 BPM
items.prompt: Instrumental medieval fantasy tactical battle loop, 144 BPM, D minor. Immediate combat pulse from the first beat. Relentless sixteenth-note low string ostinato, tight frame drums and war drums, crisp wooden percussion, syncopated accents, brief low brass stabs. Focused urgent momentum, short two-bar motif, compact dry mix with space for weapon SFX. No vocals, choir, flute solo, gentle lute arpeggios, slow ambient intro, long pads, breakdown or grand ending.
items.notes: 按用户反馈重写：提高节奏密度与推进感，减少舒缓旋律和长音；平台指定 BPM 是生成目标，导出后需检查实际节拍。
